Discover declared input schemas,required scopes,revision arguments,units,side effects and limits for live browser operations without connecting or executing them. tools.description:
Legacy mode validates saved input and returns a compact mm geometry summary, study, conditions and revision. Legacy study may contain large arrays and is not a bounded input view. Prefer section mode for revisioned bounded input inspection; section mode returns only that response, without legacy study/geometry. Optional meshIndex returns paginated observed face geometry (at most 50); face IDs belong to a display-mesh revision, not persistent CAD identities. Optional surfaceInspection requests bounded display-triangle topology diagnostics; no CAD-exact geometry, self-intersection certification or repair is performed.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__airpocket_studio__studio_inspect_project(args: unknown): Promise<CallToolResult>; };
```

tools.name: mcp__airpocket_studio__studio_job_artifact
tools.description:
Read a registered provisional mesh/scalar-time-field/nonlinear-load-step displacement artifact by jobId and artifactId. Verifies hashes and input/mesh identity; ambiguous multi-body interface points require bodyIndex or elementIndex. Returns compact statistics, optional point interpolation or a bounded node/value page (limit <= 200, default summary only). Nonlinear displacement pages contain vectors in mm and step/loadFactor, not physical time or stress. Does not accept arbitrary file paths or treat intermediate values as final.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__airpocket_studio__studio_job_artifact(args: { artifactId: string; bodyIndex?: number; elementIndex?: number; jobId: string; limit?: number; offset?: number; point?: Array<number>; }): Promise<CallToolResult>; };
```

tools.name: mcp__airpocket_studio__studio_job_artifacts
tools.description:
List registered provisional intermediate artifact metadata with bounded pagination (default 50, maximum 100), independently of event retention. Does not read or verify files; select an artifactId and use studio_job_artifact for hash-verified contents. Empty pages are not job completion.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__airpocket_studio__studio_job_artifacts(args: { jobId: string; limit?: number; offset?: number; }): Promise<CallToolResult>; };
```

tools.name: mcp__airpocket_studio__studio_job_events
tools.description:
Read new intermediate events after a sequence cursor (up to 100). Reports truncation if old events were dropped. Events carry job ID, input revision and provisional labels; field artifacts carry hashes. Empty pages are not completion.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__airpocket_studio__studio_job_events(args: { afterSequence?: number; jobId: string; limit?: number; }): Promise<CallToolResult>; };
```

tools.name: mcp__airpocket_studio__studio_job_status
tools.description:
Get a retained job state, executionSettled, resourceState (pending/settled), releaseAllowed, input revision and final artifact summary. Cancellation is terminal before execution settles; a settled execution is not proof of physical memory reclamation. Jobs are retained only for this MCP process lifetime.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__airpocket_studio__studio_job_status(args: { jobId: string; }): Promise<CallToolResult>; };
```

tools.name: mcp__airpocket_studio__studio_material_catalog
tools.description:
Read preinstalled primary-source polymer property data. Filter grades by family, filler and content; experimental formulations are separate. Poisson ratio is unpublished and must be treated as a user assumption, not manufacturer data.

exec tool declaration:

```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__airpocket_studio__studio_material_catalog(args: { contentPercent?: number; family?: string; filler?: "unfilled" | "glassFiber" | "longGlassFiber" | "glassBead" | "talc"; id?: string; includeExperimental?: boolean; search?: string; }): Promise<CallToolResult>; };
```
